title: Cross-sectional, dollar-neutral funding carry across many perps, gross exposure 1x
status: FROZEN - no carry returns had been computed when this was committed
approved_by_owner: 2026-11-07 (yes to all; data source Binance public API)
honesty_note: The author has seen the 2021-26 market regime, the H-F1 replay, and October 2026 single-coin carry results (DOGE/XRP/PEPE beat T-bills in 40-45 % of rolling 98-day windows; BTC/ETH/SOL near or below T-bills). Cross-sectional carry returns have not been computed. Parameters are textbook defaults with no search.

mechanism.payer: Leveraged longs on crowded coins pay funding; H-F1 measured $929 paid by its long side on $3,000 over 2021-26.
mechanism.position: Short the perps with the highest trailing funding, long the perps with the lowest, equal dollars per side, so market direction mostly cancels.
mechanism.main_risk: High funding usually means the coin is rising: short squeezes on the short basket; thin X-Perp books on small coins.

data.venue_proxy: Binance USDT-M perpetuals, public API (OKX X-Perp funding history reaches only 2026-08-06; OKX bulk history files would need a file download).
data.universe_source: https://fapi.binance.com/fapi/v1/exchangeInfo, contractType PERPETUAL, quoteAsset USDT, status TRADING or SETTLING (SETTLING = delisted, kept to reduce survivorship bias). Symbols removed from exchangeInfo entirely are missing: residual survivorship bias, stated in the readout.
data.candles: https://fapi.binance.com/fapi/v1/klines, interval 1d (UTC), quote volume used for the liquidity filter
data.funding: https://fapi.binance.com/fapi/v1/fundingRate per symbol, actual settlement times and intervals (8h, 4h or 1h)
data.cash_benchmark: FRED DTB3, compounded daily actual/360, holidays carried over (same as H-F1)

rule.rebalance: Daily at 00:00 UTC, using only data with timestamps before 00:00 UTC of that day.
rule.eligible: Perps with at least 30 completed daily candles and a funding print in the last 48 hours.
rule.universe: Top 50 eligible perps by mean daily quote volume over the previous 30 days. BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT are eligible like any other.
rule.signal: Mean of the funding prints in the previous 72 hours (rate per 8 hours: prints at 4h or 1h intervals are summed per 8-hour block first).
rule.short_basket: The 10 universe members with the highest signal.
rule.long_basket: The 10 universe members with the lowest signal.
rule.weights: Each basket member gets equal notional: (gross_exposure x equity / 2) / 10 per name, reset at every rebalance.
rule.execution: All trades at the daily open (00:00 UTC) of the rebalance day.
rule.delisting: If a held symbol has no candle for a day, it is closed at its last available close with normal exit costs plus an extra 10 % adverse price move, and its slot stays empty until the next rebalance.

sizing.margin: cross margin; account liquidated if equity <= 0.5 % of gross notional (checked on daily closes)

costs.charged_on: Every traded notional: entries, exits and the resize of continuing positions at each rebalance.
costs.funding: Every funding settlement strictly after the position's open time and at or before its close: payment = rate x notional at the day's open. Longs pay positive rates, shorts receive them; negative rates reverse.
costs.cost_stress_run: Same rule with slippage doubled (6 / 20 bp).

metrics.daily_return: Portfolio equity change from one daily open to the next, including price PnL, funding and costs.
metrics.max_drawdown: Largest peak-to-trough decline of the equity curve, starting equity is the first peak.

kill_criteria.K-C1: Primary (1x gross): growth over the sample <= T-bill growth over the same dates. KILL.
kill_criteria.K-C2: Primary: t_stat of daily returns < 2.0. KILL (with ~2,070 days the test has power; a weaker result is noise).
kill_criteria.K-C3: Primary: growth with the 10 best days removed <= 0. KILL (outlier dependence).
kill_criteria.K-C5: Primary: growth <= 0 in either half (slices of one continuous run). KILL.
kill_criteria.K-C6: Cost stress run (1x gross, slippage doubled): growth <= T-bill growth. KILL (thin X-Perp books).
report_only: Split of PnL into funding received/paid, price PnL of each basket, fees, slippage
Per-year growth, turnover per day, number of names held
Worst single-name one-day loss and worst portfolio day
Subset run restricted to the 148 coins listed on OKX Europe X-Perps today (survivorship-biased; tradable universe for a PL account)

Proxy calibration: for coins on both venues, X-Perp funding (eea.okx.com funding-rate-history, available from 2026-08-06) vs Binance funding over the same settlements: mean difference and correlation per coin, plus the 72h-signal basket overlap on each day of that window
kill_criteria.verdict: PASS only if K-C1..K-C6 all pass. Any failure = KILL; nothing is tuned and re-run.
